baseline_models.mechanism: The restriction and demonstrative classify the nearest life as real benefit granted for use over a span, while refusing it the status of permanent possession.

activation_trace.role: Proximity makes الدنيا the near or present life and supplies the first temporal pole without requiring moral vileness.
Enjoyable and useful benefit gives worldly life genuine usability rather than making it unreal.
Extended keeping for enjoyment makes that usability a granted tenure whose continuation is limited.
What comes after the first supplies the second temporal pole against which near-life tenure is measured.

changed_reading.before: Worldly life is merely low or worthless pleasure.
changed_reading.after: This nearest life is a genuinely useful but granted tenure, exhaustively classified as provision rather than permanence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: متاع وإن الآخرة هي دار القرار
baseline_models.mechanism: The nominal contrast places need-serving goods and provisions over against a residence whose defining condition is settled persistence: usable contents are not the home itself.

activation_trace.role: Goods, provisions, and things used to meet needs cast the present life as equipment or contents.
The resident's affiliation with a دار supplies the dwelling relation on the second side of the contrast.
Fixity and establishment make settled residence, not mere length, the latter domain's defining condition.

changed_reading.before: The first life is short and the next life is long.
changed_reading.after: The first life is need-serving equipment or movable contents; the later domain is the residence in which location and condition become settled.

baseline_models.mechanism: The possessive communal vocative turns the two-domain contrast into an insider's intervention aimed at redirecting a shared group, not a detached maxim for isolated individuals.

activation_trace.role: The human group and a man's own following supply the shared audience whose present orientation is being challenged.

changed_reading.before: A speaker states a general proposition about two lives.
changed_reading.after: A member of the community urgently asks his own people to relocate their collective horizon from present provision to settled consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated communal summons culminate in an offer of guidance along a sound path immediately before 40:39, so the focus contrast supplies that counter-route's destination and rationale.

activation_trace.role: The focus vocative anchors the changed reading in the speaker's own human community.
The earlier address to the same group establishes a sustained insider appeal rather than an isolated maxim.
The immediately preceding renewed group address joins the route offer directly to the focus address.
Gentle direction to road and truth makes 40:39 explanatory guidance rather than abstract information.
An extended traversable road supplies the spatial mechanism that leads from present tenure toward settlement.
Straight guidance away from error qualifies the offered route and opposes Pharaoh's competing direction.

structural_cues: The speaker repeats يا قوم at 40:29, 40:30, 40:32, 40:38, and 40:39.
40:38 immediately offers following, guidance, and a sound path before 40:39 names provision and settlement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated vocatives and immediate route offer; I infer that 40:39 names the route's horizon, while a live alternative is that it functions only as supporting rationale rather than as a destination label.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives communal advice detached from the surrounding dispute.
changed_reading.after: The verse is the horizon-setting step in an insider's counter-guidance against Pharaoh's claimed route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same speech first grants the people sovereignty 'today' yet exposes it to an arriving overpowering force; متاع therefore includes public rule and dominance, not only private pleasures.

activation_trace.role: Need-serving goods let the focus term reclassify political control as an instrument held for present use.
Sovereignty and rule supply the concrete collective possession that the focus later places under متاع.
A bounded present day temporally limits the people's visible sovereignty.
Overpowering force supplies the interruptibility that prevents current rule from functioning as settlement.

structural_cues: 40:29 says 'yours is the sovereignty today' within the same believing man's sequence of addresses.
The deictic pairing of اليوم in 40:29 and هذه in 40:39 narrows the present order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present sovereignty, its 'today' limit, and exposure to force; I infer that political ascendancy is a prime instance of worldly متاع, while the alternative is that 40:39 addresses life generally without targeting sovereignty in particular.

changed_reading.before: Worldly enjoyment means mainly personal wealth or sensory pleasure.
changed_reading.after: Even a community's visible sovereignty is present-use tenure: operative now, vulnerable to interruption, and not a settled possession.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verse immediately after the focus links intentional action to exact recompense and entry into the next domain, so temporary provision is the consequential arena in which settled residence is differentiated.

activation_trace.role: Fixity anchors the resulting residence in the focus phrase rather than in action alone.
Intentional action supplies the operative use made of the temporary arena by both wrongdoer and righteous actor.
Matching a deed with its recompense supplies the causal transfer from present action to settled condition.
Entry into an interior turns the hereafter from abstract duration into an assigned habitation.
Counting and account sharpen the contrast between measured consequence and provision granted there without measure.

structural_cues: 40:40 follows directly with parallel conditionals for bad and righteous action.
The sequence moves from 40:39's domain contrast to deed, recompense, entry, and uncounted provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the immediate action-to-recompense syntax and entry; I infer that worldly متاع is valuable as the arena producing a settled outcome, while an alternative is that 40:40 simply appends a separate legal clarification.

changed_reading.before: Temporary life can be dismissed because only the later duration matters.
changed_reading.after: Temporary life is not final property but is decisively consequential use-time: actions performed within it differentiate the residence that follows.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah explicitly places divine support inside worldly life and coordinates it with the day witnesses stand, so إنما متاع limits worldly tenure and mode of possession without erasing divine action or moral value there.

activation_trace.role: Genuine benefit in the focus term permits worldly life to carry aid and good without becoming permanent.
Aid that makes its recipient manifest supplies positive divine action within the near-life domain.
Life as benefit or good supports a non-nihilistic reading of the repeated phrase الحياة الدنيا.
The repeated worldly or nearest domain directly reconnects the promise of support to the focus phrase.
Resurrection and the standing of the hour supply the transition from worldly support to public final testimony.
Presence with witnessing makes the later day evidentiary and public rather than merely longer.

structural_cues: 40:51 coordinates 'in worldly life' with 'the day the witnesses stand' in one promise of support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit support in worldly life and standing witnesses afterward; I infer that 40:39 limits permanence rather than worth, while the alternative is that the promised worldly support is non-material and leaves the usual devaluation largely intact.

changed_reading.before: Calling worldly life متاع makes it worthless or abandoned by divine purpose.
changed_reading.after: Worldly life remains a site of divine aid and morally visible action; what it lacks is settled tenure, not significance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later references to an evil دار and an abiding, evil lodging prevent دار القرار from serving as an automatic synonym for bliss; it first names irreversible residence, whose quality remains morally differentiated.

activation_trace.role: Fixity supplies ontological settlement without itself deciding whether the settled condition is pleasant.
What causes distress directly qualifies a later دار and blocks an automatically favorable sense.
An adverse enclosing turn supplies the possibility that a دار can be a dreadful encompassing outcome.
Persistence not quickly reached by decay makes the punitive residence durably final.
Residence and stability in a place supply a negative counterpart to the focus's settled abode.

structural_cues: 40:52 contains the exact construction سوء الدار.
40:76 joins entry, abiding, and an evil lodging for the arrogant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an evil دار and lasting punitive lodging; I infer that القرار marks finality before felicity, while a live alternative is that the speaker pragmatically intends the favorable settled destination in 40:39 despite the broader lexical neutrality.

changed_reading.before: The abode of settlement is simply another name for paradise or peaceful rest.
changed_reading.after: The hereafter is the domain of irreversible residence; the surah can fill that finality with either uncounted provision or an evil abiding lodging.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same surah makes night a time of settling and the earth itself a قرار; worldly transience therefore contains real created stability as an enabling platform, but that local stability remains part of the larger متاع.

activation_trace.role: The focus uses fixity as the defining feature of the later abode and anchors the comparison of scales.
Inhabiting and settling supply a recurring terrestrial repose within the day-night rhythm.
Causing something to be in a condition marks earthly stability as deliberately made rather than illusory.
The lower realm opposite the sky locates this real قرار inside the worldly created order.
The repeated fixity branch explicitly grants the earth a functional place of settlement.

structural_cues: 40:64 repeats قرار for the earth and pairs it with the sky as a built structure.
40:61 embeds human settling in the alternating night-day order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies terrestrial قرار and rhythmic سكون; I infer nested levels of stability, with local created settlement inside temporary life and ultimate settlement afterward. The alternative is a strict semantic split between spatial suitability at 40:64 and duration at 40:39, but that split still makes the nesting visible.

changed_reading.before: Worldly life is sheer instability, whereas only the hereafter has any stability.
changed_reading.after: The earth offers real provisionary stability that makes worldly life livable, yet this whole stable platform remains temporary relative to ultimate settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human development terminates at a named deadline, and belief ceases to benefit once overpowering judgment is seen; the useful tenure of متاع is thus an affordance window with a cutoff, not merely an imprecisely short duration.

activation_trace.role: Being kept and granted time for use supplies the focus's bounded tenure.
Benefit supplies the functional capacity whose expiry the context reveals.
A fixed limit of time gives human stages an explicit terminal boundary.
Benefit opposed to harm becomes unavailable to belief once the response window has closed.
Seen overpowering force supplies the threshold after which late belief no longer functions.

structural_cues: 40:67 orders human life through successive stages toward a named term.
40:84-85 places recognition after seeing force and explicitly denies its later benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an appointed term and a post-manifestation loss of benefit; I infer an expiry structure for worldly متاع, while the narrower alternative limits 40:85's cutoff to late faith rather than worldly agency generally.

changed_reading.after: Worldly provision is a timed capacity for effective response: genuinely usable before its appointed boundary and unable to purchase a new outcome afterward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The livestock-and-ship sequence forms an instrumental chain of riding, benefits, reaching needs, and being carried; this activates متاع as journey equipment and recasts worldly life as a carrier rather than the destination.

activation_trace.role: A thing used for needs and passage anchors the transport reading directly in the focus term.
Riding on a mount supplies embodied transit through the provisioned world.
Benefit opposed to harm makes worldly creatures useful means rather than useless distractions.
Necessity and need specify the end served by the available equipment.
The ship moving through water extends the carrier image beyond livestock.
A carrying instrument or mount unifies animals and ships as means that bear people onward.

structural_cues: 40:79-80 chains purpose clauses: ride, eat, gain benefits, reach a need, and be carried.
Animals and ships are coordinated as parallel carriers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a dense instrumental transport chain; I infer that it materializes 40:39's متاع as world-scale journey equipment, while the alternative treats the passage only as a list of favors without extending the vehicle analogy to life itself.

changed_reading.before: متاع is fleeting pleasure consumed where one already lives.
changed_reading.after: Worldly life is furnished transport: benefits and carriers meet needs along the way, but their function itself shows that they are not the settled destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the circulation branches of د و ر and ق ل ب are more form-distant than the ordinary noun 'abode.' It remains anchored in دار القرار and is reinforced by deceptive turning through lands; downstream prose should present it only as a kinetic resonance, never as the direct translation of دار.

activation_trace.role: The circulation and exchange of conditions gives دار a secondary image of states turning through a domain.
Fixity arrests that circulation and supplies the terminal station in the exploratory mechanism.
Deception by what gleams but does not remain marks visible worldly mobility as a false sign of permanence.
Turning a thing from one face to another supplies the unstable motion that final قرار resolves.

changed_reading.before: دار القرار is a static phrase meaning only a permanent house.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, the phrase can picture a domain of turning conditions finally brought to a fixed station, in contrast to deceptive worldly circulation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the valuation branch of ق و م is form-distant from the surface قوم. It remains worth carrying because the vocative and متاع meet in one focus verse and the surah repeatedly joins earning, recompense, and account; downstream prose should call it a root-resonance of revaluation, not a lexical gloss of 'my people.'

activation_trace.role: Valuation and pricing supply a secondary summons to reassess what the community treats as valuable.
Goods and useful provisions supply the items whose apparent value is being reassessed.
Seeking and acquiring benefit supplies the worldly side of a moral ledger.
Matching action with recompense supplies the later settlement of that ledger.
Counting and account make the revaluation mechanism explicit in the surrounding surah.

changed_reading.before: The community is merely told that its goods will not last.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory root resonance, the community is summoned to reprice present goods under the account that fixes their eventual value.

strongest_changes: The nearby claim of sovereignty 'today' makes worldly متاع include collective political tenure, not only private pleasure.
The carrier sequence at 40:79-80 materializes متاع as useful journey equipment whose purpose shows that it is not the destination.
The earth's own قرار at 40:64 creates nested stability: real terrestrial settlement remains provisionary relative to ultimate settlement.
The evil دار and abiding lodging at 40:52 and 40:76 make finality morally polarized rather than automatically blissful.
The appointed term and the loss of benefit at 40:85 turn vague brevity into an expiring window for effective response.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context joined the repeated insider vocatives and immediate sovereignty-route-action sequence to distant repetitions of قرار, worldly support, timed benefit, and animal-ship carriage; it also preserved contained turning and valuation resonances that a flat temporary-versus-eternal summary would lose.
remaining_uncertainties: دار القرار may still pragmatically indicate the favorable destination in the believing man's invitation even though later usage makes final residence lexically capable of evil.
The د و ر circulation and ق و م valuation branches are live root resonances but too form-distant to state as direct lexical meanings.
40:85 securely limits late faith after manifest force, but extending that cutoff to every kind of worldly agency remains inferential.
